free_tier.stated: Fly.io bills for the resources you use, with no monthly platform fee. The smallest always-on app costs $2.19 per 30 days.

egress.terms: No free allowance. Outbound data $0.02/GB in North America and Europe, inbound free; dedicated IPv4 $2/month.; ingress: tcp+udp
egress.free_allowance: No free allowance. Outbound data $0.02/GB in North America and Europe, inbound free; dedicated IPv4 $2/month.

interface_detail: flyctl and the Machines API; services declared in fly.toml.
tooling: flyctl, fly.toml, wg-quick inside the Machine.
chaining: Fly Machine running wg-quick on a dedicated IPv4 is a working endpoint; pairs with any free client.

limits.value: no free allowance; $0.02/GB egress plus $2/month dedicated IPv4

binding_note: 1 TiB/month of egress is $20.48 at $0.02/GB, plus $2/month for the dedicated IPv4 that UDP requires, plus machine time.

identity_cost.detail: An account with a payment method; the pricing page prices every resource, with no free tier to sign up for.

reliability_note: "Fly will not rewrite the port; Fly only rewrites the IP address for UDP packets." A couple dozen bytes of MTU are taken for UDP.
confidence_note: A measured handshake would confirm the endpoint; the price and the UDP requirement are already documented.

evidence.proved: "You need a dedicated IPv4 address. You can't use a shared IPv4 address or an IPv6 address for UDP."
Dedicated IPv4 $2/month; outbound $0.02/GB NA and EU; "no monthly platform fee"

notes: Technically the cleanest WireGuard host: a real UDP port, a stable dedicated IP, and port preservation. The reason it is not a finding is that nothing is free. Cheapest realistic WireGuard endpoint found anywhere at about $2-4/month.

extras.wg_detail: "You need a dedicated IPv4 address. You can't use a shared IPv4 address or an IPv6 address for UDP." The app binds UDP to fly-global-services on the same external port.
extras.volume_stated: No free allowance. Outbound data $0.02/GB in North America and Europe, inbound free; dedicated IPv4 $2/month.
extras.transit_note: Fly's edge forwards UDP to the Machine on the same port.
